targets.authors: Shackelford, T. M., Voracek, M., Schmitt, D. P., Buss, D. M., Weekes-Shackelford, V. A., & Michalski, R. L.
targets.title: Romantic jealousy in early adulthood and in later life.
targets.evidence_quote: We conducted four replications of Shackelford and colleagues (2004).
targets.outcome_quote:
Together, the present findings can be considered a successful replication of the original results with two important
qualifications: Size of the effect and whether the effect
extends to older adults.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall successful-replication verdict with qualifications controls under rule 1 despite contrasting outcomes for younger and older samples. Shackelford is the nearest explicitly retested paper; Buss 1999 provides the reused original young sample, and is included in the meta-analysis, rather than independently designated as an additional replication target.

reasoning: Full article verified by DOI, title/subtitle and seven authors. Completed new-sample replication Studies 1–4, with accompanying meta-analysis.
